```{r}
##################################################

# these options help Stan run faster
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
        brms.backend = "cmdstanr")

# use the CSP-theme for plotting
theme_set(theme_csp())

# global color scheme from CSP
project_colors = cspplot::list_colors() |> pull(hex)

# setting theme colors globally
scale_colour_discrete <- function(...) {
  scale_colour_manual(..., values = project_colors)
}

scale_fill_discrete <- function(...) {
  scale_fill_manual(..., values = project_colors)
}

##################################################

# open data from main run
data <- read.csv("../indicom_main_data/results_Indicom-main-collapsed-N=75.csv", sep=";") 

head(data)
```



```{r}
table(data$controlCorrect, useNA = "ifany")
str(data$controlCorrect)
```

```{r}
# Count correct control trials per participant
attention_summary <- data %>%
  filter(condition == "control") %>%
  group_by(submission_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_control_correct = sum(controlCorrect == TRUE | controlCorrect == "True",
                            na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Participants who failed (< 2 correct controls)
failed_participants <- attention_summary %>%
  filter(n_control_correct < 2)

# Report
n_failed <- nrow(failed_participants)

cat("Participants failing attention checks:", n_failed, "\n")
print(failed_participants)

# Exclude them from the dataset
data_clean <- data %>%
  filter(!submission_id %in% failed_participants$submission_id)

cat("Rows before exclusion:", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Rows after exclusion:", nrow(data_clean), "\n")
cat("Participants remaining:",
    n_distinct(data_clean$submission_id), "\n")
```

```{r}

# Remove control trials from the already-cleaned dataset
df_main <- data_clean %>%
  filter(condition != "control")

```

```{r}

cat("Participants in main-trial dataset:",
```

```{r}
cat("Participants remaining:",

```

```{r}

#trim stray whitespace
df_main$contextType       <- trimws(df_main$contextType)
df_main$informationStatus <- trimws(df_main$informationStatus)

#ensure correct types
df_main$rating            <- as.numeric(df_main$rating)
df_main$informationStatus <- factor(df_main$informationStatus, levels = c(
  "at-issue-explicit", "at-issue-implicit", "no-longer-at-issue", "never-at-issue"
))
df_main$contextType <- factor(df_main$contextType, levels = c("positive", "negative"))


#get means, median and mode
mode_val <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  as.numeric(names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1])
}
 
summary_table <- df_main %>%
  group_by(informationStatus, contextType) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = round(mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median = median(rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode   = mode_val(rating),
    sd     = round(sd(rating, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(informationStatus, contextType)
 
print(summary_table, n = Inf)
write.csv(summary_table, "summary_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
message("Summary table saved to summary_table.csv")

```

```{r}
df_hypothesis <- data.frame(
  informationStatus = factor(
    c(
      "at-issue", "at-issue",
      "no longer at-issue", "no longer at-issue",
      "never at-issue", "never at-issue"
    ),
    levels = c("at-issue", "no longer at-issue", "never at-issue")
  ),
  contextType = factor(
    c(
      "positive", "negative",
      "positive", "negative",
      "positive", "negative"
    ),
    levels = c("positive", "negative")
  ),
  mean_rating = c(
    6, 2,
    5.5, 2.5,
    4, 3
  )
)

p2_hypothesis <- ggplot(
  df_hypothesis,
  aes(x = informationStatus, y = mean_rating, fill = contextType)
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:7,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 7)) +
  labs(
    x = "Information Status",
    y = "Mean Rating",
    fill = "Context Type",
    title = "Hypothesised Mean Ratings"
  ) +
  theme_csp()

print(p2_hypothesis)

ggsave(
  "plot2_hypothesised_means.png",
  plot = p2_hypothesis,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r}
#plot deltas directly -> pos - neg for each information status

delta_raw <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(contextType = tolower(trimws(contextType))) %>%
  group_by(informationStatus, contextType) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = contextType,
    values_from = mean_rating
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta = positive - negative
  )
```

```{r}
df_main <- df_main %>%
  mutate(
    submission_id = factor(submission_id),
    itemID = factor(itemID),

    informationStatus = factor(
      informationStatus,
      levels = c(
        "at_issue_explicit",
        "at_issue_implicit",
        "no_longer_at_issue",
        "never_at_issue"
      )
    ),

    contextType = factor(
      contextType,
      levels = c("positive", "negative")
    ),

    rating = ordered(rating)
  )
```

```{r}

# ── Model ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# informationStatus is the main predictor
# contextType included as a control variable
# random intercepts for participants and items
 
main_model <- brm(
  rating ~ informationStatus * contextType +
    (1 + informationStatus * contextType | submission_id) +
    (1 | itemID),
  data = df_main,
  family = cumulative(link = "logit"),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
)
 
summary(main_model)
saveRDS(main_model, "main_model.rds")
```

```{r}
main_model <- readRDS("main_model-N=75.rds")
```


```{r}
newdat <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  informationStatus = levels(df_main$informationStatus),
  contextType = levels(df_main$contextType)
)

draws <- newdat %>%
  add_epred_draws(
    main_model,
    re_formula = NA
  )
```

```{r}
draws_expected <- draws %>%
  mutate(
    category_num = as.numeric(as.character(.category))
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    .draw,
    informationStatus,
    contextType
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    expected_rating = sum(category_num * .epred),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts <- draws_expected %>%
  mutate(
    condition = paste(
      informationStatus,
      contextType,
      sep = "_"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    .draw,
    condition,
    expected_rating
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = expected_rating
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    atissue_vs_never =
      (
        at_issue_explicit_positive -
        at_issue_explicit_negative
      ) -
      (
        never_at_issue_positive -
        never_at_issue_negative
      ),
    
    atissue_vs_no_longer =
      (
        at_issue_explicit_positive -
        at_issue_explicit_negative
      ) -
      (
        no_longer_at_issue_positive -
        no_longer_at_issue_negative
      ),
    

    explicit_vs_implicit =
      (
        at_issue_explicit_positive -
        at_issue_explicit_negative
      ) -
      (
        at_issue_implicit_positive -
        at_issue_implicit_negative
      ),

    nolonger_vs_never =
      (
        no_longer_at_issue_positive -
        no_longer_at_issue_negative
      ) -
      (
        never_at_issue_positive -
        never_at_issue_negative
      )
  )
```

```{r}
extract_effect <- function(x) {

  hdi <- bayestestR::hdi(x, ci = 0.95)

  tibble(
    mean = mean(x),
    median = median(x),
    hdi_low = hdi$CI_low,
    hdi_high = hdi$CI_high,
    posterior_positive = mean(x > 0),
    posterior_negative = mean(x < 0),
    pd <- as.numeric(bayestestR::p_direction(x))
  )
}
```

```{r}
extract_effect(contrasts$atissue_vs_never)

extract_effect(contrasts$atissue_vs_no_longer)

extract_effect(contrasts$explicit_vs_implicit)

extract_effect(contrasts$nolonger_vs_never)
```
